title: Pre–Road Trip Check
subtitle: Tires, fluids, lights, kit, and documents — a calm pre-flight so the trip stays about the destination.
tone: Production EN coach (US/EU): warm mentor, visual-first, max 2 CTAs, progress %, mileage personalization, legal disclaimer every step, high-risk modal with Find a nearby shop cancel. Phase 2 road trip: visual checklist; jack/spare only with risk confirm.

ux_rules.safety_disclaimer_default: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.
ux_rules.safety_disclaimer_modal: This is general guidance only. Always follow your owner's manual or an authorized technician. This app is not responsible for damage from DIY work.

parts_checklist: Correct washer fluid / coolant top-off if needed
Emergency kit: water, triangles, cables/jump pack

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Highway trips amplify tire heat and underinflation risk — set cold PSI to the placard before you leave.
EV trips: plan chargers with weather buffer, precondition on approach, and confirm the 12V isn't weak before departure.
Tesla: enter destination for routing/preconditioning; pack the OEM cable if you'll use destination charging.
Higher-mile trip prep: prioritize cooling system leaks, belts/hoses visual, and a battery test.

risk_confirm.title: Fluid check burn / spill risk
risk_confirm.body: Only check coolant when the engine is cold. Hot pressurized coolant causes severe burns. Wipe spills and dispose of fluids properly. If levels keep dropping, find a nearby shop before a long trip.

steps.description: Confirm spare pressure or inflator charge, lug tool presence, triangles/vest if required in your region, jump pack, water, and phone cables.
steps.safety_warning: Practice jack points at home on level ground — never on a soft shoulder for the first time.
steps.safety_disclaimer: General guidance only. Follow your owner's manual or an authorized tech. This app isn't liable for DIY damage.

risk_confirm.title: Spare tire / jack practice risk
risk_confirm.body: Jacking a vehicle can cause crush injuries. Use level ground, wheel chocks, and manufacturer jack points. If you are unsure, have a shop verify the spare/inflator instead of practicing alone.
